identification: Golden Fleece SUPRA Heavy Duty Hydraulic Brake Fluid S.A.E. 70-R-3, 1 Imp. Pint rectangular tin, H.C. Sleigh Limited (Australia), c.1950s-60s. Yellow over blue, red ram-on-plinth Golden Fleece logo both faces; back face has the SAE 70-R-3 specification paragraph. Screw cap present. Condition: grubby/stained yellow, scattered scratches and small paint losses on both faces, light scrape marks across the blue band front, rim rust/wear top and base; no dents or holes seen. Fair to good collector grade, not mint. Estimate 60-100, current bid $40.
